summary: Erayak Power Solution Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, furnishing interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue rose 39.17% to $12.17 million, driven by gasoline generators (+63.80%) and inverters (+35.43%), while gross profit rose only 9.51% to $1.90 million as cost of sales climbed 46.52%. Operating loss widened 53.50% to $0.98 million and net loss deepened 47.34% to $0.76 million. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings filing, not a special situation.
